# BehavioralFeedbackLoop

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A closed-loop mechanism where epidemic prevalence alters individual vaccination opinions, which in turn modifies network susceptibility and future epidemic trajectory. Demonstrates a real-world feedback system that can be mapped to neuromorphic circuits, enabling energy-efficient simulation of adaptive social systems.
